change.title: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader
change.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/0042_reader_shard_grants.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+-- Make the reader's access to shard databases explicit so per-principal
+-- query limits and audit logging apply to it.
+GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;

verdict.headline: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader doubles meta-store row visibility from 140 to 280, but all functional metrics remain healthy
verdict.cause: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader (observed in change_statement:cr-0005). This grants the principal access to shard database r0 in addition to the existing default.* access. The meta-store tracks all tables visible to a principal, so rows_visible_to_builder doubles from 140 (default.* only) to 280 (default.* + r0.*). Bundle-builder continues reading 140 entries and writing 4390 bytes; worker-runtime exits 0 and loads 140 entries. All three experiments (baseline x-0745e5e45a7548c3, candidate x-f53d9b4b705a4b1b, control x-f81d84cc51284ead) confirm functional metrics are unchanged.
tested: x-0745e5e45a7548c3: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-f53d9b4b705a4b1b: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
x-f81d84cc51284ead: control · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: No test of actual query execution against r0.* tables under per-principal query limits; no test of audit logging behavior with the new grant. The experiment only measures meta-store visibility and functional pipeline metrics.
Baseline and candidate both passed under every tested workload.

causal_chain.edge: h1: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader in the migration. The meta-store tracks all tables/grants visible to a principal. With the new grant on r0.*, svc_bundle_reader now sees both default.* (140 rows) and r0.* (140 rows) = 280 total rows.
